description: Reads one model and reports what is wrong with it in plain terms (holes, inward faces, a doubled surface, self-intersections, loose fragments...), its size, and the repairs a built-in draft would add for it. Changes nothing.

details.description: Also return the Inspector's raw readouts.

path.description: The model file (glTF, GLB, FBX, OBJ, PLY, OFF or STL); its textures and buffers are read from the same folder.

name: inspect_model
title: Inspect a model
